comparison.objective: Align a replacement pipe with an installed pipe and slide a coupling across their joint.
comparison.physical_skill: One arm maintains collinear end alignment while the other slides a sleeve across the support junction.
comparison.success_condition: Coupling spans both pipes, replacement pipe remains aligned and seated, then hands release and the assembly stays stable.
comparison.reason: The central tested ability closely matches the candidate: bimanually align two end-to-end supports and slide a guided component across their junction without opening the interface. Preserving loose balls adds a failure constraint and precision burden, but does not clearly establish a meaningfully different core manipulation ability.
